landing.subtitle: Join the elite. Experience personalized online coaching.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Start your journey to your best version.
welcome.letter_p1: Hello, Thank you for trusting me to accompany you in this process. I want you to know that this is not just another training program. It is the beginning of a real transformation, based on commitment, honesty, and constant work.
welcome.letter_p2: My goal is not only for you to achieve visible results, but for you to enjoy every step of the way. I want you to learn, to be surprised by what you are capable of achieving, and to build a new mindset towards training and your health.
welcome.letter_p3: This program combines the principles that really work with a practical application adapted to you. The important thing is to do the essentials well, constantly and with criteria.
welcome.letter_p4: We are going to work together, and I want you to know that I will be with you in every doubt, in every advance, and in every difficulty. My commitment is total.

workflow.title: How Your Program Works
workflow.hevy_desc: Create your account on Hevy and search for me as "Daviddetena". There you will receive your personalized routine.
workflow.routine_desc: Your plan is designed with the principles that work best, adjusted to your level and context.
workflow.tracking_desc: Direct communication via WhatsApp. Ask what you need and let's keep active contact.
workflow.video_desc: Send me videos of your key exercises. I will review your technique and give you specific feedback.

commitment.title: Your Commitment
commitment.desc: For your process to work to the max, commit to this:
list: Be honest with my sensations and feedback
Send my videos when asked for technical review
Commit to at least 8 weeks of continuous follow-up
Notify in advance if there are changes in availability

points: A chain is only as strong as its weakest link
To look strong you have to be strong
Pain is not just damage, it is a sign of weakness

tracking.title: Monitoring and Recovery
tracking.desc: During your process, we will review your progress, rest, and mood together. I want to know how you feel, what sensations you have, how you are resting. Not just your results.
tracking.sheet_desc: Before starting, you must fill out a form where I will collect key information about your history, goals, and current state. This form will allow me to generate your personalized tracking sheet. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask me.

support.title: Support and Contact
support.desc: I am available for you. Contact me for any questions:

items.q: When will I receive my routine?
items.a: Once you complete the tracking form, you will receive your personalized routine on Hevy within 48 hours.

items.q: How do I send my technique videos?
items.a: Directly via WhatsApp. Record exercises from a side angle that allows me to see your full posture and send them when I request or when you have doubts.

items.q: What if I can't train one day?
items.a: Let me know as soon as possible. We will adjust the calendar and redistribute sessions so you don't lose progress. Flexibility is key.

items.q: What happens if I have discomfort or pain?
items.a: Tell me immediately. We will adapt the exercise causing discomfort, evaluate the situation, and adjust your routine. Your health is always the priority.

items.q: Can I change my follow-up schedule?
items.a: Of course. Talk to me in advance and we will adjust video calls and the plan to your new availability. Flexibility and commitment go hand in hand.
